Later source refactoring preserved that wording in the active OperationOutcome StructureDefinition.

Related combined-branch commit 31b85ae8851c759e854e3fb8a5db2dcaf1e7bbc6 for FHIR-18513 already fixed a later source/help.html glossary occurrence.
